verdict.rationale: The Gemini API Additional Terms state that on Paid Services Google doesn't use your prompts, files or responses to improve its products. On Unpaid Services, submitted content is used to improve and develop ML technologies, so preventing training requires moving to the paid tier rather than flipping an opt-out. Missing for 10: an opt-out control available on the free tier, independent or hands-on corroboration of the paid-tier no-training commitment, and explicit wording about model training rather than 'improve our products'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: When you use Paid Services, including, for example, the paid quota of the Gemini API, Google doesn't use your prompts (including associated system instructions, cached content, and files such as images, videos, or documents) or responses to improve our products
